name: Ookouchi Nozomi
source:
The daughter of Dream Town's representative. She is a cheerful young lady who enjoys assisting those in need. She is engaged to Ryuuya, but she is concerned that Ryuuya's feelings are not for her.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/レミニセンス_(ゲーム)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
